reopen_condition: Reopen only with a new outcome-independent execution substrate that guarantees semantic observability for every accepted bounded training action before an API call is made. The task, model, data, strategy payload, boundary definition, and no-task-hop rule remain fixed unless a new candidate identity is created; a reopened unit must first re-establish PRE headroom, and prior NO_EVIDENCE runs cannot be reused as scientific outcomes.

action_turn_asset.reusable_precheck: Before a bounded paid-agent causal arm, freeze an arm-invariant action-turn contract that limits diagnostic actions, defines handling of prose-only planning, and guarantees that a pre-boundary turn cannot consume the budget indefinitely without a declared tool action.
action_turn_asset.does_not_imply: strategy non-adherence, method failure, or core-principle failure

reuse_scope.failure_mode: planning or diagnostics consume provider turns without reaching the scientific action endpoint

action_turn_asset.source_reopen_condition: Freeze an arm-invariant action-turn contract before a fresh paid unit; do not repair by task hopping, outcome-selected prompting, or forcing the desired training method.

semantic_observability_asset.reusable_precheck: Before authorizing any causal arm whose intervention boundary depends on a training or update action, audit the full accepted action surface so every accepted configuration either produces an independently verifiable persisted semantic update or is rejected before the scientific unit starts; support failures must map to NO_EVIDENCE.
semantic_observability_asset.does_not_imply: strategy non-adherence, method failure, or core-principle failure

reuse_scope.agent_experiment: causal intervention with a runtime-defined semantic boundary
reuse_scope.failure_mode: syntactically valid action completes but produces no independently observable state or parameter update

semantic_observability_asset.source_reopen_condition: Reopen only after outcome-independent semantic observability is guaranteed for the accepted training-action surface before a fresh PRE unit.
